plainLanguage: Texas sets a minimum house code (the 2012 IRC) but most cities use the newer 2021 IRC with local changes - always confirm with your city. The statewide energy code is still the 2015 IRC energy chapter; a newer one is under state review. Your county decides your climate zone and so your insulation and window levels. Cities cannot require fire sprinklers in a house. Cities generally cannot require brick or stone, but your HOA or deed restrictions can. On the coast you need a TDI windstorm certificate to get wind insurance. Much of Texas has shrink-swell clay, so plan on an engineer-designed slab.
